label: Gaming Highlights
description: Impact-led highlights balancing setup, payoff, reaction and occasional deliberate chaos.
intent: Make the highlight understandable and exciting; setup is often necessary for the payoff.
avoid: cutting away before the decisive play
excessive shake that hides the action
opening: Show the most compelling moment without fabricating a reaction or removing necessary context.
editing: Retain approach → impact → reaction, varying density with game intensity.
typography: Concise high-contrast annotations; avoid obscuring important gameplay HUD.
sound: Protect game cues and speech; emphasize major actions, not every button press.
critique: Can the viewer follow why the play matters and experience the impact?

creative_contrast.when: A new idea, action or visual fact arrives
The viewer needs to read, understand or feel something
